newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: CZECH PX50 REBOUNDS AT FIXING LED BY BLUE CHIPS.
newsitem.headline: CZECH PX50 REBOUNDS AT FIXING LED BY BLUE CHIPS.

text.p: The Czech PX50 rebounded 0.7 percent to 493.5 at Friday's fixing as gains from major issues outweighed losses in the broader market where the majority of shares moved lower.
The resurgance was led by SPT Telecom which rose 46 crowns to 3,000, CEZ which gained 27 crowns to 928 and Komercni Banka which was up 57 crowns to 1,970.

Dealers warned, however, that prices had been posted on low volumes, saying no clear trend was likely to emerge until the central bank's interest rate policy became clearer and the crown fully stabilised.
Dealers expect a loosening of monetary policy from the central bank later on Friday or early next week, saying the current squeeze on liquidity is unsustainable.
It is not clear whether the central bank will lower the discount rate from the current 13.0 percent or whether it will be content to cut the repo rate which currently stands at around 75 percent.
